## Problem and scope

Who needs this, and what concrete behavior should change?

## Proposal and alternatives

Identify affected contracts, components and ADRs. Mark research hypotheses explicitly.

## Evidence and limitations

Link primary sources and explain what they support and do not establish.

## Data, permissions and costs

Describe external effects, provider dependencies and resource limits. Include no secrets.

## Acceptance

Give a reproducible check, baseline where applicable, and failure/rollback behavior.
